title: How Did We Learn to Count

shots.line: How did humans learn to count?
shots.scene: title: narrator thinking, thought bubble with a question mark, marker title

shots.line: Forty thousand years ago, nobody had numbers.
shots.scene: savanna wide: caveman walks in with a spear, date label pops

shots.line: So how do you keep track of anything?
shots.scene: close-up caveman confused, question mark pops

shots.line: You scratch a line for every one.
shots.scene: cave: caveman scratches tally marks on the wall by the fire

shots.line: And that simple idea is still with us today.
shots.scene: two-shot: modern narrator meets the caveman, arrow and light bulb

shots.line: Lines became groups, groups became numbers.
shots.scene: board diagram: tally, arrow, 5, arrow, 1 2 3 4 5, check
